# SYNTHETIC placeholder letters — not real ASL

These six "letters" (a, b, c, d, e, j) are **geometric stand-in hands**,
generated by `tests/fixtures/make_synthetic_fingerspelling.py`. They are
not recordings and not real ASL handshapes. They exist only to exercise
the fingerspelling pipeline in a real browser before the real alphabet is
recorded (`pose_library/FINGERSPELLING_PLAN.md` Section 7). Every file says
so: `source: "synthetic:placeholder"`.

Never copy these into `pose_library/fingerspelling/`.

Manual check: from `frontend/`, run the dev server with
`FINGERSPELLING_POSES_DIR=../tests/fixtures/fingerspelling_synthetic`,
then look up words spelled only from these letters, e.g. `cab`, `bead`,
`jade`.
